items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: you had Tom Anderson. And Lula White, she just had a piano player. And Tom Anderson.

ctx.x: Well, would they have the bands in the houses or the cribs or the cabarets or what?

No, they were in cabarets. Yeah, you had Pete Lawless at Rice Cafe, you had Tom Anderson. And Lula White, she just had a piano player. And Tom Anderson. And Pete Barrett, they didn't have no band. And there was about four or five places around there that had bands working. Well, Henry Martin, the drummer I was telling you about, he used to work with Peter Bocas. Peter Bocas. Was it Peter Bocas? I think it was Peter Bocas. I used to work with Peter Bocas at the Rice Cafe. And that's at the corner of Iberville and…

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: No, like Tom Anderson and that place.

ctx.x: I thought you might have gone there.
No, like Tom Anderson and that place. I never got up Tom Anderson's?
No. You never got up Tom Anderson's?
